title: Century Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Northern Ireland Road Transport Board

content.caseIdentity: Century Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Northern Ireland Road Transport Board, [1942] AC 509 (House of Lords)
content.holding: A petrol tanker driver who lit a cigarette and threw a burning match while discharging petrol was held to be acting in the course of employment. The act of lighting the match was an unauthorized and negligent mode of conducting an authorized task.
content.relevance: Leading authority demonstrating that an unauthorized mode of an authorized task remains within the course of employment.
